rules.build:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
# The Makefile sets its own flags. Those of Debian's recipe, without # _FILE_OFFSET_BITS files of more than 2 GiB can't be read on 32 bit systems. make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS" \ CC="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc" \ CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -Wall -Winline" \ CPPFLAGS="$CPPFLAGS -D_REENTRANT -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64" \ LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS"
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" install
# The manual pages, in PREFIX/man. rm -rf "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/man"
ln -sf bzdiff "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzcmp" ln -sf bzgrep "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzegrep" ln -sf bzgrep "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzfgrep" ln -sf bzmore "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzless"
# With Debian's makefile.diff bzip2 is the program and bunzip2 and bzcat are # links to it, with the install directory in them. Make them relative. rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bunzip2" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzcat"
ln -s bzip2 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bunzip2" ln -s bzip2 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzcat"
# A link that leads nowhere would be packaged without a word. test -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzip2" test ! -L "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/bzip2"
